messages:
Marta (CSM): FYI team 1: Marlin Systems QBR scheduled Thu 10am PT. Need final deck + 1-page follow-up plan by Wed 5pm PT. Main goals below.

Marta (CSM): Goals:
- Reconnect exec sponsor and confirm success metrics
- Show onboarding progress with concrete usage signals
- Surface renewal posture + mitigation plan
- Share enablement assets and next steps
- Capture open feedback with owners and dates

Ethan (CS Ops): I'll take health slide. Plan: MAU 90d sparkline, error rate last 30d, and integration success rate. Which success metric do you prefer for integrations? installs or success_runs?

Priya (AE): Use success_runs (it ties to value). Renewal note: sponsor engagement is cool but quiet; propose a 20-min exec demo + commitment ask. I'll draft the renewal slide and a concession (30-day performance credit).

Marta (CSM): Sponsor is "Kenji Sato" (CTO). Priya, please add a proposed agenda for the exec demo: 10m outcomes, 5m tech wins, 5m sponsor ask.

Leo (Enablement): I'll prep a 12-min enablement video focusing on admin onboarding and billing reconciliation. Office hours Tue 11am PT, recording + 1-pg checklist will be uploaded.

Anya (SE): For onboarding blockers, running quick queries for module adoption. Short SQL IA0run below: 
```sql
SELECT module, pct_active, pct_completed FROM module_adoption WHERE account='marlin' ORDER BY pct_active DESC LIMIT 8;
```
Will paste CSV + one-slide PNG.

Ethan (CS Ops): I'll include a small incident timeline and add a short note on the recent latency regression fixed last week.

Marta (CSM): Action items (reply DONE when complete):
```
- Ethan: Health slide (MAU sparkline, error rate, integration success_runs) due Wed 5pm
- Anya: Adoption CSV + PNG slide due Tue EOD
- Leo: Enablement video + checklist due Wed 5pm
- Priya: Renewal mitigation + exec demo agenda due Wed 5pm
- Marta: One-pager followup plan + speaking bullets due Wed 5pm
```

Priya (AE): Quick ask: can SEs export a perf dashboard screenshot? That visual helped last time.

Anya (SE): On it. Will drop perf-snap.png to /drive/marlin/qbr/assets and anonymize any customer quotes.

Ethan (CS Ops): Capturing feedback owners: billing -> Leo, API docs -> Anya, admin UX -> Marta. I'll add that to the "Open Asks" slide with target dates.

calendar-bot: Reminder created: upload final deck 24h before meeting.

Marta (CSM): Thanks all 1: if we close these actions we should turn the renewal from amber to green. Ping here for blockers. :thumbsup:
